module origen_058141 (
    output reg clk,
    output reg reset,
    output reg [3:0] cperiod_v,
    output reg cperiod_tc,
    output reg p1,
    output reg [4:0] cout,
    output reg enable,
    output reg [3:0] cperiod_v_2,
    output reg cperiod_tc_2,
    output reg p2,
    output reg [1:0] cperiod_v_3,
    output reg cperiod_tc_3,
    output reg div_n,
    output reg [3:0] count,
    output reg [1:0] factor,
    input [3:0] period
);

    // Clock generation
    initial begin
        clk = 0;
        forever #10 clk = ~clk;
    end

    // Reset generation
    initial begin
        reset = 0;
        #100 reset = 1;
        @(posedge clk) reset = 0;
    end

    // Main counter
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            cperiod_v <= 4'b0;
            cperiod_tc <= 1'b0;
            p1 <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (cperiod_v == 4'b1111) begin
                cperiod_v <= 4'b0;
                cperiod_tc <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                cperiod_v <= cperiod_v + 1'b1;
                cperiod_tc <= 1'b0;
            end
            p1 <= (cperiod_v == 4'b1010);
        end
    end

    // Enable generator
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            cout <= 5'b0;
            enable <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (cout == 5'h14) begin
                cout <= 5'b0;
                enable <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                cout <= cout + 1'b1;
                enable <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // Periodic counter
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            cperiod_v_2 <= 4'b0;
            cperiod_tc_2 <= 1'b0;
            p2 <= 1'b0;
        end else if (enable) begin
            if (cperiod_v_2 == period) begin
                cperiod_v_2 <= 4'b0;
                cperiod_tc_2 <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                cperiod_v_2 <= cperiod_v_2 + 1'b1;
                cperiod_tc_2 <= 1'b0;
            end
            p2 <= (cperiod_v_2 == 4'b1010);
        end
    end

    // Division counter
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            cperiod_v_3 <= 2'b0;
            cperiod_tc_3 <= 1'b0;
            div_n <= 1'b0;
        end else if (enable) begin
            if (cperiod_v_3 == 2'b11) begin
                cperiod_v_3 <= 2'b0;
                cperiod_tc_3 <= 1'b1;
                div_n <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                cperiod_v_3 <= cperiod_v_3 + 1'b1;
                cperiod_tc_3 <= 1'b0;
                div_n <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // Output counter
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            count <= 4'b0;
        end else if (div_n) begin
            count <= count + 1'b1;
        end
    end

    // Factor counter
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            factor <= 2'b0;
        end else if (div_n) begin
            factor <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            factor <= factor + 1'b1;
        end
    end

endmodule
